about: The old engine's numbers: PR #568's store engine before the xbf engine (the store, the build daemon, a model's STEP as its file; VERSION 0.8.0, main merged through 0.7.24, not a main release: tom's at 830f3ae86, memory/warm-edit-regression-2026-10-18.md:368, hypercar's and juno's edits and colds from the round-2 branch merged at 12c14d7e1, ibid.:176-189, their STEP sizes and times from the same branch's xbf-cost bench, ibid.:377-380), measured on the maintainer's machine on 2026-10-19 at load 7-10 and kept as the baseline, never measured again. Each number names the note it was recorded in (`source`: `memory/` is the maintainer's Claude Code memory of this repository, `side-session-notes/` the Claude app's side-session notes) and the words that say it (`line`). The same numbers stand as the numbers to beat in side-session-notes/xbf-engine-recovery.md:28, and tom's in side-session-notes/xbf-corpus-baseline-2026-10-21.md:21-27. This recorded baseline is retained as measured. A model or measure missing here has no old number and no comparison; this release does not rerun the old engine.
